exercises.explanationUz:
13-14-UNITLAR TESTI - 20 savol.

  -ING: 6 don't mind DOING, 11
    loves BUYING, 14 hates DRIVING
  TO-INFINITIV: 2 would like TO
    BUY, 8 remember TO GO, 10
    forgot TO TAKE, 16 decided TO
    TAKE UP, 20 Would you like TO
    GO
  YALANG' INFINITIV: 13 made me
    CLEAN, 18 mustn't PLAY, 19
    would ORDER
  KO'ChIRMA GAP: 1 he WAS getting
    married (said → o'tgan), 15
    she LIVED, 5 The children
    STOPPED talking (entered -
    o'tgan)
  SAY / TELL / ASK: 3 TOLD me a
    joke, 9 Gertrude SAID that, 12
    Heather SAYS that, 17 Nina
    TOLD me that
  KO'ChIRMA SAVOL: 4 HOW old I was,
    7 WHO was on the phone

  ⚠ made + KIM + yalang' fe'l.
  ⚠ 'tell a joke' - told me a joke.


⚠ 'HORSEBACK RIDING':

  = ot minish.

items.textEn: A: What did Jake say? B: He said that he ___ getting married.
Beatrice would like ___ some flowers.

Adrian forgot ___ out the rubbish last night.
Harry loves ___ people gifts.
Heather ___ that she likes walking in the rain.
My mother made me ___ the windows.

A: Would you like ___ to the opera tonight? B: Yes, I'd love to.

patterns.formula: love / hate / don't mind + -ING;  would like / decide / forget / remember + TO + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: Harry loves buying people gifts. John decided to take up horseback riding.
patterns.exampleUz: Harri odamlarga sovg'a olishni yaxshi ko'radi. Jon ot minishni boshlashga qaror qildi.

patterns.exampleEn: My mother made me clean the windows.
patterns.exampleUz: Onam meni derazalarni tozalashga majbur qildi.

patterns.formula: KIM + said (that) / told KIMGA (that) + EGA + O'TGAN ZAMON
patterns.exampleEn: He said that he was getting married. Nina told me that she sold her computer.
patterns.exampleUz: U turmush qurayotganini aytdi. Nina menga kompyuterini sotganini aytdi.
